verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs show models loaded via `lms load` with custom identifiers while the server runs separately via `lms server start/stop`. On-demand loading means sending an inference request to an unloaded model loads it before the request returns, so models can be switched through the API without restarting the server. A community user also mentions an eject button for unloading models in the app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that several models can stay loaded at the same time, a documented unload command or API, and independent hands-on confirmation of switching under the server.
